representation.fit_ids_hash_encoding: ordered signed int64 little-endian array, without header
representation.source_hash_encoding: ordered articles: int64le id, int64le first_seen, uint64le UTF-8 title byte count, title bytes
representation.category_policy: all nonpadding articles use the original first UNKNOWN category column
representation.scalar_feature_policy: reuse the original content_features 13 scalars; SVD axes are not ranker features
representation.artifact_policy: trusted local only; do not publish estimators, titles, vocabulary, IDs or feature rows
